tei:div.tei:p: bla ma gser gling pas jo bo la mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i chos su gnang ba bzhugs so/ /mgon po bla ma gser gling pa'i zhal nas/ jo bo la bu khyod mtha' 'khob 'dul ba la chos 'di rnams dgos gsungs/ rtog pa thams cad 'bur 'joms te/ /gnyen po thams cad bcom rdeg yin/ /'dun ma thams cad gcig 'gril te/ /lam rnams thams cad gcig chod yin/ /gnyen po rnam byang chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /'khor ngan log sgrub bzod pa la/ /snyigs ma'i dus su mkho ba yin/ /rkyen ngan dge ba'i bshes gnyen te/ /'dre gdon rgyal ba'i sprul pa yin/ /na tsha sdig sgrib kyi phyags ma ste/ /sdug bsngal chos nyid kyi yo langs yin/ /kun nas nyon mongs kyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /skyid kyi kha non chen po ste/ /sdug gi mjug sdud chen po yin/ /na na nad g.yog chen po yin/ /gcig pu sdod na skyo grogs yin/ /mi mkho shos ni 'dod thog yin/ /ltas ngan g.yang du len pa yin/ /gnyen po log gnon gyi chos bzhi ste/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /bdag ni skyon gyi rtsa ba ste/ /rgyangs kyis bskyur ba'i chos gcig yin/ /gzhan ni yon tan gyi 'byung khungs te/ /bcangs te len pa'i chos gcig yin/ /spang gnyen mjug sdud kyi chos bzhi te/ /mtha' 'khob 'dul na dgos pa yin/ /log cer log na cer cer ltos/ /shig ge shig la 'bol ler zhog /des ni mi 'ching grol bar 'gyur/ /zhes gsungs so// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 gser gling pa/ gser gling pas jo bo rje la gnang ba'i mtha' 'khob 'dul ba'i chos/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
